recommend APPROVAL of amendments to the City’s Commercial Architectural Standards in Sections 18.65.060, 18.70.060, 18.75.050, 18.80.060, 18.85.060, 18.95.040, 18.100.060, and 18.215.030 of the Riverton City Code with the following changes: 1. Increase allowed glass coverage to a maximum of 50% of any one side. 2. Move the definition of “rusted metal” from prohibited to approved accent materials. 3. Increase the allowed percentage of accent metal to not exceed 20%. Commissioner Keele

recommend APPROVAL of amendments to minimum lot size for Multi-family Developments in Sections 18.45.050; 18.50.050; 18.53.050; 18.55.050; 18.57.050; and 18.60.050 of the Riverton City Code, with the following changes: 1. There should be no changes to the RM-6 Zone. 2. RM-8 and RM-8-D Zones should be changed to a 2-acre minimum, but allow an exception of a minimum lot size of 0.8-acres on main thoroughfares. Commissioner Matheson

recommend APPROVAL of amendments to the Riverton City Code Section 18.135.200, Temporary Commercial Uses, addressing temporary commercial uses on residential property, as presented. Commissioner Rushton
